{{Quote|Isn't it toxic?''"<br />"''Only if the dosage is wrong, so get your mixture right.|Unidentified Mandalorian male and [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]]|<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''Mandalorian''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked at the [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|shipping docks]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He helped the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] mix the poisonous [[Slabin/Legends|Slabin]] with [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]]. He was arrested when [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and others discovered the plot.
